about.title: About Me
about.description1: I am Oumayma, a passionate developer and artist. My journey has always been divided between two worlds: code and painting. Both disciplines taught me the same thing: creativity has no limits.
about.description2: Since I was young, I paint to express what cannot be said with words. Every canvas is a conversation between my soul and the blank void, filled with emotions, colors, and dreams.
about.description3: This gallery is a reflection of my artistic evolution, where science meets art, where logic dances with emotion.

timeline.desc1: I started painting seriously and developing my own style.
